lesson.grammar_point: verbs followed by gerund or infinitive
phases: The Words of the Next Step

listenings.text: When I sit in on a negotiation, I listen to the verbs more than the numbers, because the verbs tell me what each side has actually promised. There is a big difference between we agreed to extend the deadline and we discussed extending the deadline. The first one is a decision. The second one is a conversation, and nobody has to honor a conversation. Founders mix these up all the time, and they usually mix them up in the dangerous direction. They walk out of the room saying the buyer agreed to keep the team, when what the buyer really said was that he would consider keeping the team. Consider is not a promise. It is a polite way of delaying a decision. So before you report anything to your board, ask one question about every sentence. Is this something somebody decided to do, or something somebody might do one day? If you cannot tell, you do not have an agreement yet. You have a mood.

There is one phrase I ban in my first week with any executive, and the phrase is I will try to. Not because trying is bad, but because nobody on the other side of the table can do anything with it. If you tell a buyer you will try to send the numbers by Friday, he hears that he will not get them by Friday, and he plans for that. So say what you are committing to instead. We will send the audited numbers by Friday, and the forecast by the following Wednesday. That is two promises, both of them smaller, and both of them believable. The other habit I work on is the apology. Senior people do not apologize for delaying things. They explain what they decided to do, and when. I am sorry for being late with this sounds like a junior analyst. We decided to wait for the auditor sounds like somebody who is running the process. The information is exactly the same. The position in the room is not.

extra_audio.text: Quick update on today's session with Keller. We agreed to proceed with full due diligence from Monday. Grant suggested restructuring the earnout, but he did not offer a number. I refused to disclose the client list before exclusivity is signed. Until we see a number in writing, let's avoid discussing the earnout. I will commit to sending the retention figures by Monday, and nothing else.
